read.where: Rum is distilled from **sugarcane**: its fresh juice, its syrup, or **molasses**, what’s left after making sugar. Most rum is made from molasses. There’s **no single world rulebook**: each country sets its own rules. In the EU, rum is bottled at **37.5% or more**.
read.mixup: **Rum** comes from **sugarcane**. **Tequila** comes from **agave**. Both can be clear and unaged.
read.sayIt: Rum’s made from sugarcane, so it has a little natural sweetness.

is richer, from longer aging or added caramel.

read.bigIdea: Light to rich, with a few kinds apart.
read.where: **White** rum is unaged or filtered after aging, so it’s light. **Gold** rum has some time in wood. **Dark** rum is richer, from longer aging or added caramel. **Spiced** rum is flavored with spices like vanilla and cinnamon. **Rhum agricole** is made from **fresh cane juice**, so it tastes **grassy** and bright.
read.mixup: **Dark** doesn’t always mean older. Some dark rums get their color from **caramel**.
read.sayIt: That’s a white rum, so it’s light. For something richer, try a dark one.

keyPoints.line: is the most common rum call.
white, gold, dark or spiced: they taste different.
is often sipped neat or on the rocks.

read.bigIdea: Ask which rum: they taste different.
read.where: The most common rum order is **rum and cola**. Ask **which rum**: a light **white** rum, a richer **dark** one, or a **spiced** one all change the drink. Some guests sip **aged rum** **neat** or **on the rocks**, like whiskey. If they name the bottle, it’s a **call**.

stops.name: Rum and cola
stops.text: With **cola** over ice, often with lime.

read.mixup: **Spiced** rum is flavored. **Dark** rum is richer from aging or caramel. They aren’t the same bottle.
read.sayIt: Would you like a white rum, or something richer, like a dark rum?

keyPoints.line: is rum, lime and sugar, shaken.
is rum, lime, orange curaçao and orgeat.
is dark rum and ginger beer.

read.where: The **Daiquiri** is rum, lime and sugar. The **Mojito** adds mint and soda. The **Mai Tai** is rum, lime, orange curaçao and **orgeat**, an almond syrup. The **Dark ’n’ Stormy** is dark rum and ginger beer. The **Piña Colada** is rum, pineapple and coconut.
read.mixup: The **Mai Tai** has **orgeat**, made from almonds. Mention it to any guest with a **nut allergy**.
read.sayIt: It’s a rum drink: bright, tropical and easy to like.

facts.fact: Rum is distilled from sugarcane: its fresh juice, its syrup, or molasses, what’s left after making sugar. Most rum is made from molasses. There’s no single world rulebook: each country sets its own rules. In the EU, rum is bottled at 37.5% or more.

facts.fact: White rum is unaged or filtered after aging, so it’s light. Gold rum has some time in wood. Dark rum is richer, from longer aging or added caramel. Spiced rum is flavored with spices like vanilla and cinnamon. Rhum agricole is made from fresh cane juice, so it tastes grassy and bright.

facts.fact: The most common rum order is rum and cola. Ask which rum: a light white rum, a richer dark one, or a spiced one all change the drink. Some guests sip aged rum neat or on the rocks, like whiskey. If they name the bottle, it’s a call.

The Daiquiri is rum, lime and sugar. The Mojito adds mint and soda. The Mai Tai is rum, lime, orange curaçao and orgeat, an almond syrup. The Dark ’n’ Stormy is dark rum and ginger beer. The Piña Colada is rum, pineapple and coconut.
